run_glue_fine_tuning: run a transformers model fine-tuning pipeline on a GLUE text classification task without the Trainer API
parse_glue_cli_args: parse command-line arguments for GLUE fine-tuning including task name, model path, batch size, and learning rate
preprocess_glue_dataset: preprocess a GLUE dataset by tokenizing sentence pairs and mapping labels to model-compatible IDs
fine_tune_sequence_classification: fine-tune a pretrained transformers sequence classification model on custom CSV or JSON training data
evaluate_glue_model: evaluate a fine-tuned model on GLUE validation sets including accuracy and regression metrics
